With your new ship, a Rapier, you will learn new combat techniques. You will notice that you have two secondary weapons: torpedos and heavy rockets. Torpedos are farily accurate and powerful, and good at close or long range. Torpedos should be used if you cannot see the ship visually, but only on radar. They work by selecting a target, then selecting "Torpedos," and pressing "q" to fire. Heavy rockets are innacurate but very powerful, and only good at close range. The same procedure is used to fire Heavy Rockets as Torpedos. This ship also has a rear laser turret. This type of weapon does not require you to be pointing at a ship, only that it is targeted and behind you. It is a primary weapon, fired with the space bar. This mission requires that you destroy two Academy target ships, both with harmless weapons. Report back to Levo when you have completed the mission. Good luck.
